items.summary: Ryan is doing incredible work with Gauntlet Loops! Ryan Campbell (@Ryancampbell) Built 4 games this month using @mattshumer_ gauntlet loop. Using Opus 5 for all. The latest game MoonBase One was built over 2 days from a single prompt. I added a note to the gauntlet prompt to first pull learnings and code from the previous games. All built with @threejs . Next I'm thinking I'll build a FPS in a monorepo along with the other games and let a gauntlet loop focus on shrinking the code base of each game while building up a shared library.. with the goal of decreasing effort to build new games over time. I have Grok 4.6 currently building a smart tv/gaming console as well so I can enjoy these on my tv (plus you can talk to Grok, Claude or Codex by saying "yo homie" ha). 2026 is pretty fun so far :) Play them here: racing.ryancampbell.com umbranine.ryancampbell.com moonbase.ryancampbell.com — https://nitter.net/Ryancampbell/status/2089019695236276696#m
